decision_conditions:
The London Borough of Islington make the following observations;

All the matters highlighted within the Environmental Impact Assessment Scoping report, listed in the contents page, should consider cross boundary impacts to properties and land located within the London Borough of Islington.
description: Request for an Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) Scoping Opinion under Regulation 15 of the Town and Country Planning (Environmental Impact Assessment) Regulations 2017 (as amended), in respect of the demolition of existing buildings and structures on site, the construction of a 35-storey building containing 22,000sqm of co- living  floorspace  (sui  generis)  and  a  seven-storey  building containing 6,000sqm of office floorspace (use class E) [Hackney Reference: 2025/1388].
status: Called in by Secretary of State
street_name: Finsgate House, 5-7 Cranwood Street, Hackney, London, EC1V 9LH
